title: Illumination Drift Detection

verification_checks.details: Expected arrays, shapes, dtypes and finite values validated.
Reconstructed reference, calibration and evaluation image and identity counts match recorded counts. Exact original identity membership was not independently preserved.

comparison_policy.nan_values: Compared as equal where both original and regenerated values are NaN

remaining_limitations: The original NPZ binary was not recovered.
Byte-for-byte equivalence with the original NPZ cannot be established.
Exact element-for-element equivalence with the original NPZ cannot be established.
Exact original identity partition membership cannot be independently confirmed without the original partition index or identity lists.
The regenerated archive reproduces the recorded numerical statistics, thresholds and detection results within the stated tolerances.
These results do not establish real-world biometric recognition accuracy, fairness, bias mitigation or production readiness.
final_interpretation: The recorded Experiment 11 numerical results were independently reproduced from the regenerated embedding archive. All audited statistics, thresholds, detection analyses, diagnostics and individual permutation-level results passed their comparisons. The regenerated archive must not be represented as the recovered original binary.
